claim_policy.lifecycle_coverage: Coverage means that every stage has an explicit state, gate, artifact route, and responsibility boundary. It does not mean every stage has passed a real-review validation.
claim_policy.profile_coverage: Every declared review family can enter the shared lifecycle, but profile-specific methods and native synthesis depth are reported separately.
claim_policy.validation_boundary: Schema or fixture tests establish technical behavior only. Published reconstruction and prospective performance require separately frozen evidence.
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not infer scientific validation from a schema or smoke test.
Do not infer native statistical support from workflow coverage.
Do not infer autonomous validity from AI-first execution.
Do not claim first, comprehensive validation, human equivalence, or labor savings without direct evidence.

lifecycle_stages.title: Topic selection and feasibility
validation_evidence: time-boundary, target-leakage, false-opportunity, deterministic-ranking, diversity, and sealed-rediscovery fixtures
lifecycle_stages.human_boundary: AI builds and ranks the evidence-grounded portfolio by default; accountable stakeholders own value choices and the final production topic signature, while historical AI-only evaluation uses sealed published expert references after run lock.
known_gaps: Automatic source-complete landscape construction and calibrated overlap/freshness signals remain pending.
No held-out historical or prospective topic-opportunity validation has passed.

lifecycle_stages.title: Protocol, registration, and amendments
validation_evidence: tests/test_ai_control_plane.py protocol compiler and freeze-readiness fixtures
lifecycle_stages.human_boundary: Protocol freeze, registration, and material amendments require an accountable human signature.
known_gaps: Registry submission remains a credentialed human action.

lifecycle_stages.title: Search, deduplication, and lawful retrieval
validation_evidence: local command and source-adapter validation; published end-to-end recall pending
lifecycle_stages.human_boundary: Institutional logins, licensed exports, and unresolved access rights remain user-controlled handoffs.
known_gaps: No end-to-end recall validation across all required licensed databases.
Conclusion-directed acquisition controller requires domain calibration.

lifecycle_stages.title: Deduplicated record and full-text selection
lifecycle_stages.human_boundary: Production-review eligibility follows the selected authority; AI-only replacement is restricted to preregistered evaluation mode.
known_gaps: Held-out hard-negative and full-text false-exclusion calibration pending.

lifecycle_stages.title: Multimodal full text, lineage, and extraction
lifecycle_stages.human_boundary: Unresolved documents, inaccessible supplements, conflicting numbers, and final accepted extraction follow the profile/mode responsibility rule.
known_gaps: Global multimodal result-state solver and diverse real-PDF benchmark remain pending.

lifecycle_stages.title: Risk of bias, missing evidence, and poolability
lifecycle_stages.human_boundary: The dossier may be AI-generated; final RoB, certainty inputs, and poolability are accountable scientific judgments.
known_gaps: Only selected appraisal frameworks have typed adapters; domain-specific real-case agreement is pending.

lifecycle_stages.title: Data freeze and deterministic synthesis
validation_evidence: 61 local R adapter fixtures passed before this matrix revision
lifecycle_stages.human_boundary: The accountable analyst approves the estimand, pooling decision, deviations, and final analysis freeze.
known_gaps: Published reconstruction across all synthesis families and clean environment lockfiles remain pending.

lifecycle_stages.title: Certainty, thresholds, and interpretation
lifecycle_stages.human_boundary: Final certainty and clinical or policy interpretation require accountable domain judgment.
known_gaps: Profile-specific certainty adapters beyond the current shared dossier route are incomplete.

lifecycle_stages.title: Reporting, AI review, revision, and release
validation_evidence: claim compiler and citation identity fixtures
lifecycle_stages.human_boundary: External submission, authorship, disclosure, response to reviewers, and release require human responsibility.
known_gaps: End-to-end changed-artifact verifier and journal-specific reporting adapters need expansion.

lifecycle_stages.title: Living surveillance and change-impact update
lifecycle_stages.human_boundary: Publication-trigger, conclusion-change, notification, and retirement decisions remain accountable decisions.
known_gaps: Scheduled provider integrations and prospective full-rerun equivalence are pending.

review_profiles.label: Intervention effectiveness
limitations: Non-randomized intervention appraisal and complex estimands still require profile-specific authority and judgment.

review_profiles.label: Network meta-analysis
limitations: Transitivity, network geometry, ROB-MEN, and CINeMA remain scientific judgments; published reconstruction is pending.

review_profiles.label: Diagnostic test accuracy
limitations: QUADAS versioning, threshold effects, and comparative tests need review-specific handling.

review_profiles.label: Prognostic factor
limitations: No dedicated prognostic-factor adapter or published reconstruction; crude and adjusted estimates must remain separate.

review_profiles.label: Prediction model
limitations: No native performance/meta-regression adapter for discrimination, calibration, or validation-type synthesis.

review_profiles.label: Etiology, risk, or exposure
limitations: Causal estimands, confounding structures, and adjusted-effect harmonization are not automated away.

review_profiles.label: Prevalence
limitations: Sampling frame, case definition, denominator, and transformation choice need domain validation.

review_profiles.label: Incidence
limitations: Person-time definitions, recurrent events, and rate standardization need explicit contracts.

review_profiles.label: Harms and adverse effects
limitations: Attribution, grade, competing risk, recurrent event, and reporting-window semantics are not a generic binary outcome.

review_profiles.label: Dose-response
validation_evidence: linear and spline dose-response R fixtures
limitations: Reference dose, covariance, exposure harmonization, and nonlinearity assumptions need prespecification.

review_profiles.label: Individual participant data
validation_evidence: controlled HEPSANET material plan; IPD access is not public
limitations: No native one-stage/two-stage IPD pipeline; governance, harmonization, clustering, and data access remain study-specific.

review_profiles.label: Outcome measurement instruments
limitations: No native COSMIN property-specific synthesis or certainty adapter.

review_profiles.label: Scoping review
limitations: Mapping and charting are supported by the shared workflow; effectiveness pooling must not be implied.

review_profiles.label: Qualitative evidence synthesis
limitations: No native meta-aggregation, meta-ethnography, or GRADE-CERQual workbench.

review_profiles.label: Mixed-methods review
limitations: No executable convergent or sequential integration transform with validation.

review_profiles.label: Economic evidence review
limitations: No native cost normalization, model appraisal, or economic synthesis adapter.

review_profiles.label: Umbrella review or overview
limitations: No native overlap matrix or corrected-covered-area engine yet; primary-study double counting remains a hard guard requirement.

review_profiles.label: Rapid review overlay
limitations: Shortcuts and their likely biases must be declared; this overlay does not make an incomplete search comprehensive.

review_profiles.label: Living systematic review overlay
limitations: Surveillance provider scheduling and prospective conclusion-change validation are pending.

review_profiles.label: Prospective or cumulative review overlay
limitations: Prospective evidence governance is broader than cumulative meta-analysis or TSA and remains protocol-specific.

review_profiles.label: Other explicitly specified review family
limitations: A new authority, profile contract, appraisal route, and synthesis route must be pinned before scientific execution.

synthesis_routes.label: Pairwise common or random effects
limitations: Estimand alignment and dependency must be resolved before execution.

synthesis_routes.label: Network meta-analysis
limitations: Transitivity and consistency are scientific assumptions, not software outputs.

synthesis_routes.label: Bivariate or HSROC diagnostic synthesis
limitations: Comparative tests and threshold structure need profile-specific extension.

synthesis_routes.label: Proportion or prevalence synthesis
limitations: Transformation and denominator decisions remain prespecified choices.

synthesis_routes.label: Incidence-rate synthesis
limitations: Person-time and recurrent-event compatibility must be established.

synthesis_routes.label: Multilevel meta-analysis
limitations: Dependency structure and cluster identifiers must be scientifically correct.

synthesis_routes.label: Robust variance estimation
limitations: Small numbers of independent clusters can invalidate nominal inference.

synthesis_routes.label: Linear and nonlinear dose-response
limitations: Within-study covariance and dose harmonization require explicit inputs.

synthesis_routes.label: Bayesian random-effects synthesis
limitations: Prior choice and sensitivity analysis cannot be delegated to defaults.

synthesis_routes.label: Subgroup and meta-regression
limitations: Study-level associations are vulnerable to ecological bias and low power.

synthesis_routes.label: Component network meta-analysis
limitations: Component additivity must be defensible.

synthesis_routes.label: Rare-event sensitivity routes
validation_evidence: Peto, Mantel-Haenszel, and GLMM adapter fixtures
limitations: No single method is universally appropriate for zero-event structures.

synthesis_routes.label: Cumulative and trial-sequential analysis
limitations: Information-size and error-spending assumptions require justification.

synthesis_routes.label: Reporting-bias and small-study sensitivity analyses
validation_evidence: funnel, Egger, Begg, trim-fill, and PET-PEESE fixtures
limitations: These methods do not diagnose publication bias mechanically.

synthesis_routes.label: Multivariate meta-analysis
limitations: No native typed adapter or benchmark yet.

synthesis_routes.label: One-stage or two-stage IPD synthesis
limitations: No native IPD harmonization and modelling pipeline.

synthesis_routes.label: Prediction-model performance synthesis
limitations: No native calibration, discrimination, or O:E synthesis route.

synthesis_routes.label: Prognostic-factor association synthesis
limitations: No dedicated adjusted-effect and prognostic appraisal adapter.

synthesis_routes.label: SWiM or profile-specific structured synthesis without pooling
limitations: The reporting contract is documented but not yet represented by an executable structured-synthesis schema.
